title: Science
description: The scientific method, kept as the work happens: investigations into what is not yet known, the hypotheses they test, the experiments that test them and the results that bear them out or refute them, with the hours and commits each took. An investigation's record, for any year, is read off the map.

types.title: Investigation
types.description: One line of investigation: something that could not be known or done from what was already known, worked at by testing hypotheses. Its hypotheses, experiments and results are part of it. The title names what is sought; the note says why it was not known and how it was looked for.

baseline.description: What was already known when it began, and why that did not answer: the methods and sources tried first.

types.title: Hypothesis
types.description: A belief about the world that could be wrong. The title is the statement; its prediction says what would show it false. Make it part of the investigation it belongs to.

prediction.description: What should be observed if it holds, and what would refute it.

types.title: Experiment
types.description: A task that tests a hypothesis and produces a result. Its method says how it is run, so it can be run again. The hours it takes are time entries part of it, and an agent's time counts to it while its session names it as its task.

method.description: How it is run: what is varied, what is measured, and against what.

types.title: Result
types.description: A recorded outcome with its evidence: a measurement, a test run, a reply.

evidence.description: Where the proof is: a path, URL or commit.

links.title: tests
links.description: The work that will settle the hypothesis.

links.title: assumes
links.description: The source only makes sense if the hypothesis holds. Flagged at risk when it is refuted.

views.description: Open work that rests on a refuted hypothesis (it assumes one), each with the hypothesis it rests on: what was planned on a belief the evidence has since gone against.

The record of investigations over a year (all of it unless year is given): for each, what was uncertain (its hypotheses, with their predictions), what was done (its experiments, with their method, the hours people logged by person, the hours agents' sessions spent, and the commits that settle them), what was learned (its results, with what each supports or refutes), and the totals. unlogged lists the experiments that carry no hours. Without of, every investigation with work in the year.

of.description: An investigation's id. Without it, every investigation.

year.description: A year, as 2026: only what was done, logged or learned in it.

views.description: The record as rows, one line each: every investigation with its hours and commits, then what was uncertain (its hypotheses), what was done (experiments, with hours and commits) and what was learned (results). This year's unless year or of (one investigation, all of it) is given.

styles.title: Experiments carry their hours
styles.body: When you work on an experiment, name it as your task with report, action session_update, so your session's time counts to it. When the owner says how long they spent on one, log it as a time entry part of the experiment. An experiment with no hours is listed as unlogged in its investigation's record.
